meta.name: process-mapper
meta.description: Map, measure and improve business processes — SIPOC and swimlane capture, cycle-time and bottleneck analysis, handoff diagnosis, and a payback-ranked improvement backlog. Use when a process is slow, error-prone, or crosses too many teams.

copy.tagline: 画出流程全貌,量化瓶颈,按效益排出改进清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正为流程太慢、差错多而头疼,却不知道卡在哪。
copy.tagline_en: Draw the full process map, quantify bottlenecks, and rank fixes by payback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a slow, messy process and need to know what to fix first.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你梳理业务步骤和每步耗时,画出流程图,分析哪个环节最慢、交接是否混乱,并给出一份按回报高低排序的改进清单。它还会区分劳动时间节省和等待时间节省,避免高估收益。
howto.when: 当流程很慢、容易出错、或跨太多团队时触发。

say.text: 帮我把订单审批流程画成 SIPOC 和泳道图,并测出每步的等待时间。
say.note: Claude 会先确认流程范围和用时数据来源。

say.text: 哪些环节之间的交接最耽误时间?指出瓶颈并给改进建议。
say.note: 会运行交接分析,输出交接密度和瓶颈。

say.text: 按回报从高到低排一份改进待办,把返工率高的步骤放前面。
say.note: 会根据投入产出比排序,并区分节省的类型。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through mapping and measuring a business process: drawing flowcharts, analyzing cycle time, bottlenecks, and handoffs, then outputting an improvement backlog ranked by payback. It also separates labour savings from wait-time savings to avoid overstating benefits.
howto.when_en: Activates when a process is slow, error-prone, or crosses many teams.

say_en.text: Map our approval process as SIPOC and swimlane; measure each step's wait.
say_en.note: Claude will clarify scope and data sources first.

say_en.text: Which handoffs waste the most time? Diagnose bottlenecks and suggest fixes.
say_en.note: It runs handoff analysis and reports density and wait share.

say_en.text: Rank improvement actions by payback, putting high-rework steps first.
say_en.note: It sorts by ROI and distinguishes labour vs. lead-time savings.
